intro: Write, follow conversations, and keep life organized. Apps made for your everyday.
otherIntro: For keeping track, catching up, and looking back.
aboutTitle: It starts with an everyday need.
aboutText: KUMAKIKAI turns small frustrations in learning and daily life into simple, useful apps.
supportTitle: A little help when you need it.
supportText: Find guides and answers to common questions for each app. For questions or bug reports, get in touch by email.
themeToggle: Switch between light and dark mode
developmentScreenshot: Screen from the app in development

uni-note.name: Uni:Note
uni-note.description: Write with Apple Pencil. Annotate PDFs. Organize notes by subject and folder, then use AI to create practice questions or ask about a problem you circle. From taking notes in class to reviewing them later.
imageAlts: Uni:Note on iPad showing handwritten lecture notes made with Apple Pencil
Uni:Note on iPad showing practice questions generated from notes and answer cards

oto-miru.name: OtoMiru
oto-miru.description: From television to everyday conversations, see spoken words in large text on your iPhone or iPad when listening is difficult.
imageAlts: OtoMiru displaying speech as large captions
OtoMiru with large buttons for TV, Conversation, and Group listening

giga-poke.name: GigaPoke
giga-poke.description: Keep povo 2.0 reward codes in order of expiry. Copy the code you need and check your next data reward right from a widget.
giga-poke.note: An unofficial app for managing povo 2.0 rewards. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or otherwise associated with KDDI Corporation, povo, or au.
imageAlts: GigaPoke listing povo reward codes in order of expiry
GigaPoke Home Screen widget showing days remaining and a button to copy a reward code

nocca.name: Nocca
nocca.description: For people who find conversation or contact with family overwhelming. Share just what you need to say, while family members receive your message and reply when needed.
imageAlts: Nocca development screen for sharing wishes such as “I would like food” and “I cannot talk right now” using icons
Nocca development screen explaining the roles of the person sharing their wishes and the family member receiving them

uni-note-pocket.name: Uni:Note Pocket
uni-note-pocket.description: Review your Uni:Note notes on iPhone. A read-only companion that imports your backups.
imageAlts: Uni:Note Pocket displaying handwritten Uni:Note notes on iPhone
Uni:Note Pocket bookshelf with notes and subjects imported from a backup

balance-calendar.name: Balance Calendar
balance-calendar.description: Record income and expenses as they happen. Look back at your daily finances in a calendar.
imageAlts: Balance Calendar entry screen with plus and minus buttons for recording income and expenses
Balance Calendar showing recorded income and expenses by day, month, and year

smokeless.name: Smokeless
smokeless.description: Log when you smoke or resist a craving with a tap. See changes in your cigarette count and spending.
imageAlts: Smokeless home screen for logging smoking and resisted urges
Smokeless statistics showing cigarettes smoked and urges resisted

signal.name: SIGNAL
signal.description: Read independent voices from note, Qiita, Zenn, and more, at your own pace.
imageAlts: SIGNAL CREATORS feed listing articles by individual creators
SIGNAL settings for selecting feed sources
